recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No current FHIR core source work is needed for FHIR-7582; any future terminology change should be handled through the terminology/UTG process and account for the FHIR-11151 split.
issue_request: FHIR-7582 was Published/Persuasive with Modification for DSTU1 AllergyIntolerance. It asked how to specify active or resolved allergies and requested clarity between allergy activity and confirmation, with the approved resolution to add active as an ancestor for confirmed and unconfirmed and to define the status codes; resolved was already present.
initial_application: The historical application is visible in the 2015-08-20 source history. Commit 895df7d512162acde0f7ccde8a9cdfb19d0290a9 added the active AllergyIntolerance.status code, placed unconfirmed and confirmed under it, and updated the status short label. The adjacent commit 4aafeeebac46b47f643f2d49a5a619d0cb000f72 explicitly cites '#7582 - added status active', tying that application set to this seed issue.
additional_context: The old combined AllergyIntolerance.status hierarchy was later refined by FHIR-8599 and FHIR-10067, then superseded by FHIR-11151, which split activity and certainty into clinicalStatus and verificationStatus. FHIR-11206 and FHIR-15525 further confirm the same status-family interpretation. The current source/fhir.ini actively includes AllergyIntolerance, and current THO terminology defines active/resolved clinical statuses plus the verification statuses.
reconciliation: No source edit was made. In the current build-scope StructureDefinition, AllergyIntolerance.clinicalStatus covers active, inactive, and resolved, while AllergyIntolerance.verificationStatus covers unconfirmed, presumed, confirmed, refuted, and entered-in-error. This preserves active confirmed and active unconfirmed combinations without reviving the obsolete combined status hierarchy.
